Implementation coverage

Coverage by namespace

Percentages compare Orion’s fully implemented functions, events and properties with those supported by the selected baseline — MDN (supported by any browser per MDN’s data, the default), a single browser, or “All sources” (MDN plus the Chrome-only catalog). Chrome-only catalog members count under the Chrome and All-sources baselines. A single-browser baseline omits namespaces that browser does not ship; the MDN view lists everything measurable. Types and parameters are excluded; partial implementations and stubs do not count as implemented.
